quotes.text: Traders are expressly prohibited from engaging in copy-trading activities between funded accounts held under different names or individuals. However, copy-trading is permissible when conducted across multiple funded accounts under the Trader's own name and solely for the purposes of risk management and strategy diversification.
Traders can analyze and execute trades on a single chart while seamlessly replicating them across multiple accounts via a trade copier.
